decision_rules.equivalence_rule: Declare PRESERVED only when the destination representation satisfies the feature contract; otherwise record the observed difference or partial evidence without inferring semantic absence from a single extractor encoding.
decision_rules.uncertainty_rule: If a feature-specific equivalent cannot be established with the available destination evidence, retain the frozen outcome but label the evidence UNRESOLVED_EQUIVALENCE or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; use MEASUREMENT_FAILURE only when the measurement path fails.
